The temple is part of the UNESCO World Heritage property 'Great Living Chola Temples'.

retrieved.source_title: Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram
retrieved.excerpt: Located directly on the seashore, the Shore Temple has endured centuries of exposure to wind and salt spray from the Bay of Bengal. Mahabalipuram was a major port city of the Pallava dynasty, and its monuments include chariot-shaped rathas, cave sanctuaries, and giant open-air reliefs such as the Descent of the Ganges, reflecting Pallava art and religion.
